Potrero with a VIEW! This architecturally significant home designed by well known architect, Robert Hersey, celebrates distinct design with a focus on light, air, and dramatic angles. Detached on 3 sides, the residence boasts sweeping views of Downtown skyline and Bay.  The main level of the home integrates dining, living and lounging with a wood burning fireplace & hardwood flooring. Anchored by the bold Scavolini cabinets, the Italian kitchen features a Viking Stove, Asko dishwasher and Italian Quartz countertops. The lower levels of the home feature 3 spacious bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms. From the lush garden patio enjoy the fruit bearing trees- lemon, fig, & avocado- and take in the colors of the sky as they dance from day to night. Detached garage with parking easement. Close to public transportation, the 101 & 280. Relish in one of the sunniest neighborhoods in the City & experience all of the shops, restaurants, & cafes of Potrero Hill, Dogpatch,& Inner Mission.

Whole upper floor of a two-unit house on the north slope of Bernal. Private entrance at the street, your own staircase, nobody overhead.
Start with the bay. The living room's front bay window looks out over rooftops toward the downtown skyline, with a built-in window seat under it. The room is wide and open, and it holds the afternoon light. Coved ceilings, picture rail, and oak floors in good shape run through the whole main level.
The bedrooms are the reason to take this place. Two on the main floor are genuinely full-size, well past the shoebox dimensions you usually get at this price in Bernal. Both have ceiling fans, real closets, and tall windows on the garden side looking into treetops rather than a lightwell.
The third bedroom is the attic: the whole top floor, freshly finished, skylights on both slopes, recessed lighting, and its own sink and toilet. It runs the length of the house, so there's room up there for more than sleeping.
Separate dining room with lots of natural light. Galley kitchen with a gas range, dishwasher, and refrigerator, and a door straight out to a fenced private deck that gets good afternoon sun. Full bath has a jetted tub and a window that opens, plus a separate half bath so nobody's waiting. Heat is electric wall units, one per room, so you're not paying to warm rooms you're not using.
On location: short walk to Precita Park, and Bernal Hill is up from there — the off-leash top with the 360 views, worth the climb even without a dog. Holly Park and Garfield Square are both close. The other direction puts you on 24th Street in the Mission for the everyday stuff: La Palma, the produce markets, Philz, Alley Cat Books, Dynamo. Cortland is the neighborhood main street for groceries and the library. 24th St BART plus the 12 and 27 lines get you downtown.

Welcome home to this bright and spacious top-floor 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom apartment in one of San Francisco’s most desirable neighborhoods. Filled with natural light and thoughtfully updated throughout, this inviting home offers generous living spaces, an updated kitchen with dishwasher, and the convenience of one-car parking.
The open living and dining area creates an ideal space for both everyday living and entertaining. The updated kitchen features crisp cabinetry, stone countertops, modern appliances, and a dishwasher, with a dedicated dining area just beyond the kitchen.
The spacious primary bedroom is comfortably sized for a king-size bed, nightstands, and additional furnishings, while the two additional bedrooms can easily accommodate queen-size beds and home office or storage furniture. The thoughtful floor plan gives the primary bedroom and one bathroom their own private wing, separated from the additional bedrooms by the central living area.
Both bathrooms retain the building’s charming vintage character while offering practical layouts. One features a walk-in shower, while the other offers a shower/tub combination. Skylights bring an abundance of natural light into both spaces.
Additional features include newer flooring in the living areas, brand-new bedroom carpeting, double-paned windows throughout, and one-car parking.
An Exceptional Richmond District Location!
This home puts the best of San Francisco’s Richmond District, Golden Gate Park, and Pacific Ocean coastline right outside your door. The neighborhood offers an incredible mix of outdoor recreation, local restaurants, coffee shops, markets, and everyday conveniences—all within easy walking distance.
Spend the morning exploring Golden Gate Park, grab coffee and breakfast along Clement Street, or head west for an afternoon at Baker Beach or Lands End. The neighborhood’s proximity to some of San Francisco’s most spectacular parks, trails, beaches, and scenic overlooks makes this an especially appealing location for anyone who enjoys an active, outdoors-oriented lifestyle.
Bright, spacious, updated, and exceptionally well located—355 24th Avenue #302 is a wonderful place to call home.
